name: Nanmoku (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Nanmoku village emblem in white: a crown-like device above a ring enclosing a small ring.
history: Municipal flag of Nanmoku, a village in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 22 March 1968.

features.role: Nanmoku village emblem — a crown-like device above a ring enclosing a small ring
